pr_title: Fix Inconsistent RepositoryData on First Repository Mount
pr_body:
Add mechanism that forces tracking the repository generation in the
cluster state before it is first used to avoid races between the first
write of repository data and the next operation (e.g. when doing
concurrent snapshot creation right after mounting a repository) in
extreme corner cases.

Closes #66663
Closes #67199

review_comments: This is kind of brute force admittedly, technically this could be mixed in with `executeConsistentStateUpdate` but since we probably want to merge this back to `7.11` I didn't want to interfere with other infrastructure for the initial fix. Also, this fix can be done without BwC concerns with slight adjustments in the backport which is not necessarily true if `executeConsistentStateUpdate` gets changed.
